issue_context.title: lightning failed with error “tidb lightning encountered error: fetch tso from pd failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = server not started” when pd rolling restart
comments:
from @lance6716 
need a function like IsLeaderChange can judge retry, which need to be provided by pd
![img_v3_0276_4955bf52-369b-4121-83d1-f838e53dfe8g](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/assets/84712107/584d53d0-e5cc-4da7-9555-52a339d3b8b0)
We have plans to introduce a retry mechanism within pd client. I'll follow up on this

review_comments:
When meets unexpected error, we don't want to backoff, should fail-fast

And for tolerable error, we don't want a retry limit, 1 minute maybe not enough.
I think the correct solution is not add another retry layers. We have too many retry layers now. API should know what specific error types are retryable and do not let caller bother the retry logic.
Yes, I will check the error in backoffer

IMO, for pd clients as a whole, caller should be able to give options as to what errors should not be retried and how many times.
Of course, the pd client should also provide a common default backoffer to deal with most cases, such as lightning. And this is exactly the starting point for maintaining a layer of backoff mechanism in pd client. PD's developer should maintain what kind of errors should be retried.
